name: stack-history-fallback
summary: Show recent history when the branch has no pending stack
body:
On the trunk the merge-base collapses and the stack pane was a bare
empty-state — useless for exactly the repos ism has already organized.
It now falls back to the recent log, where every commit shows its
Isomer-Change identity chip straight from the trailer; history cards
are static (no hunk data to review).
